author: Thrasillias
body:
Unban Apeal Eldrin

Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed)  Eldrin
The reason you were temp-banned/banned   Ban Evasion [iTz_iPVP_] By Emmaye
Why you should be unbanned from the server.  I want an unban because I feel really bad about ban evading with Elthanorr. When I ban evaded I knew the risks and the consequences and it ended coming true. All that I ask is that you give me a second chance by unbanning me as I do truly regret what I have done and if I had the chance to go back and think about the choices of ban evading or not I would decide not to ban evade. I have truly learnt my lesson and I wish to come back to playing in game with my friends.
